discoveryPrivacy.description: Keeps DNS-SD URIs and raw Windows WSD device IDs inside the trusted main process; returns keyed HMAC-SHA-256 selectors with process-lifetime scope, invalidated on fresh WSD discovery, and hides IP literals or IP-looking .local names.
